question: Give me a map of airport density — count how many airports fall in each 10-degree worldwide grid cell
sql: WITH grid AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(t.generate_series, u.generate_series, t.generate_series+10, u.generate_series+10) AS geom FROM generate_series(-180, 170, 10) AS t CROSS JOIN generate_series(-90, 80, 10) AS u), joined AS (SELECT g.geom, a.name FROM grid g JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, g.geom)) SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(geom) AS grid_cell, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM joined GROUP BY geom HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY airport_count DESC

question: List the top 5 major airports that have the most other airports within 200 km
sql: SELECT a1.name, a1.iata_code, COUNT(a2.name) AS nearby_airports FROM airports a1 JOIN airports a2 ON a1.name <> a2.name AND ST_Distance_Spheroid(a1.geometry, a2.geometry) <= 200000 WHERE a1.type = 'major' GROUP BY a1.name, a1.iata_code ORDER BY nearby_airports DESC LIMIT 5

question: Compare airport types by how clustered they are — give me the average number of other airports within 100 km for each type
sql: WITH neighbor_counts AS (SELECT a1.type, a1.name, COUNT(a2.name) AS neighbor_count FROM airports a1 LEFT JOIN airports a2 ON a1.name <> a2.name AND ST_Distance_Spheroid(a1.geometry, a2.geometry) <= 100000 GROUP BY a1.type, a1.name) SELECT type, AVG(neighbor_count) AS avg_neighbors_within_100km, COUNT(*) AS total_airports FROM neighbor_counts GROUP BY type ORDER BY avg_neighbors_within_100km DESC

question: Give me the 10 most isolated airports — those with the fewest other airports within 500 km
sql: SELECT a1.name, a1.iata_code, a1.type, COUNT(a2.name) AS airports_within_500km FROM airports a1 LEFT JOIN airports a2 ON a1.name <> a2.name AND ST_Distance_Spheroid(a1.geometry, a2.geometry) <= 500000 GROUP BY a1.name, a1.iata_code, a1.type ORDER BY airports_within_500km ASC, a1.name ASC LIMIT 10

question: List the 10 airports with the closest nearest neighbor — give me each airport and its distance to the nearest other airport in km
sql: SELECT a1.name, a1.iata_code, MIN(ST_Distance_Spheroid(a1.geometry, a2.geometry))/1000 AS nearest_neighbor_km FROM airports a1 JOIN airports a2 ON a1.name <> a2.name GROUP BY a1.name, a1.iata_code ORDER BY nearest_neighbor_km ASC LIMIT 10

question: Compare world regions by longitude — count airports in each 30-degree longitudinal band and map the bands
sql: WITH bands AS (SELECT t.generate_series AS band_start, ST_MakeEnvelope(t.generate_series, -90, t.generate_series+30, 90) AS geom FROM generate_series(-180, 150, 30) AS t), counts AS (SELECT b.band_start, b.geom, COUNT(a.name) AS airport_count FROM bands b LEFT JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, b.geom) GROUP BY b.band_start, b.geom) SELECT band_start, band_start+30 AS band_end, airport_count, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom) AS band_geometry FROM counts ORDER BY band_start
